summary: CICS online User List screen (admin function). Displays a scrollable, paginated list of user security records with forward/backward paging; the user can select a row to update (U) or delete (D) that user, which transfers to the corresponding maintenance program. Pseudo-conversational.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.pseudocode: Pseudo-conversational entry. On first entry send the first page of users. On re-entry evaluate the key: PF3 return to admin menu; PF7 page backward; PF8 page forward; Enter act on a selected row. Return to CICS.
branches: EVALUATE EIBAID: PF3 / PF7 / PF8 / ENTER

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-ENTER-KEY
paragraphs.pseudocode: Check the row-selection flags: a 'U' selection transfers to the update-user program and a 'D' selection to the delete-user program for the chosen user id; an invalid selection shows an error.

annotations.note: BUSINESS RULE: a listed user may be selected for Update (U) or Delete (D).

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Browse the user file forward filling the next page until full or end-of-file.
branches: READNEXT loop until page full or EOF

paragraphs.name: PROCESS-PAGE-BACKWARD
paragraphs.pseudocode: Browse the user file backward filling the previous page until full or top-of-file.
branches: READPREV loop until page full or BOF

paragraphs.name: SEND-USRLST-SCREEN
paragraphs.pseudocode: Populate the header and the user rows and send the list map.
